description: Kartläggning av hartsträ i CT-skanningar av tall med en hybrid Gaussian Mixture Model bildsegmentering pipeline is a dataset listed in Sweden's data portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Luleå Tekniska universitet. The presence of resinwood in Cronartium pini-infected Scots pine stems represents a major quality concern, diminishing timber value and challenging processing workflows. Although X‑ray computed tomography (CT) provides a non‑destructive means of visualising internal density, robust and automated methods to separate resinwood from heartwood and sapwood in such scans remain underdeveloped. Coverage: Luleå Tekniska universitet. The portal shows the English title as "Mapping resinwood in CT scans of Scots pine with a hybrid Gaussian Mixture Model image segmentation pipeline" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Luleå Tekniska universitet. Its keywords include Computational imaging, Image processing, Forest health and pathology, Timber engineering, Computer vision. The listing shows 2026-01-23 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-oppnadata.
